title: Hidden Objects
description: Hidden Objects is a visually stunning puzzle game that challenges your observation skills. Explore beautifully detailed scenes filled with cleverly hidden items. Use hints if needed, but the real reward lies in uncovering every object on your own. Dive into a world of mystery and sharpen your perception.

title: Max Speed
description: Race shiny sports cars on thrilling 3D tracks full of jumps, stunts, and intense battles. Explore exciting locations with unique challenges, perform daring tricks, upgrade and customize your cars, and test your skills in fast-paced arcade races. Enjoy high-speed action, stunning visuals, and nonstop adrenaline right in your browser.

title: Meteoheroes
description:
THE PLANET’S SUPERHEROES
Fulmen, Nix, Nubess, Pluvia, Thermo and Ventum are six children that one day find out that they have superpowers.
Train the skills and superpowers of each MeteoHeroe in the gym with six games of marksmanship, speed, ability, coordination, strength, and synchronization.

title: Ball Craze Sort
description:
Ball Craze Sort is a fun, relaxing, and addictive puzzle game where your goal is to sort colorful balls into the correct order. What starts as a simple task quickly turns into a brain-teasing challenge as more colors and tubes are introduced.
Ball Craze Sort is the perfect game to unwind or mentally recharge. Whether you’re looking to relax for a few minutes or challenge your logic skills for hours, this game offers the ideal balance between fun and focus.

title: Solitaire Klondike: Eternal Russian Classic
description:
Rediscover the captivating world of Solitaire Klondike!

This timeless card game not only entertains but also enhances logical thinking, offering hours of engaging pastime. Play your favorite solitaire anytime, anywhere.

Join the community of enthusiasts and prove your mastery in Klondike!

Keep an eye on the leaderboard and become the top player among all!

title: Quiz Master
description:
Quiz Master is a fast-paced casual quiz game where you race against the clock—and other players—to prove you’ve got the wittiest brain in town.
Each match drops you into a question showdown spanning everything from pop culture and geography to brain-rot challenges.
When you answer a question correct you get 1 Block that will save you. If you pick the wrong answer you will stay where you are.
The water rises so make sure to answer correctly or you get eaten by the sharks.

title: Papa Buzja
description:
Papa Buzja brings good things home! He feeds the children, brings them books, makes supplies and builds a house. The path will pass through wide fields, dense forest, squelching swamp and high mountains.
Difficultes and adventures await Papa Buzja along the way. 
Whatever happens on the way, remember: the kids are waiting for you!

title: Oreplication
description: Sandbox strategy tycoon where you design factories for infinite wealth. Start with basic droppers & conveyors, upgrade to advanced machines. Deep progression, mystery boxes, endless optimization—build, outsmart, ascend in the ultimate factory challenge!

title: Color Block Jam 2
description: Play Color Block Jam 2 free online in your browser with no download and no install required. This free online puzzle game lets you slide colorful blocks into matching gates through smart logic levels designed to test your brain and timing. Perfect for fans of cool math games, unblocked games, and quick school breaks, it loads fast and works smoothly on desktop and mobile. Enjoy relaxing color block puzzles anytime, anywhere, completely free.

title: Sandbox - Destroy the Ragdoll
description:
Ready to destroy and earn? In this sandbox clicker, it's simple: choose your weapon, attack characters, and get paid for the damage you deal. The stronger your attacks, the bigger the reward!  

Use different tactics, unlock new gear, and upgrade your firepower. The further you go, the more powerful the weapons and the greater the possibilities. Ready to become the strongest fighter? Then tap, destroy, and earn!

title: Moscow Metro Driver 3D
Komaru cat
description:
Take care of Komaru the cat! Pet her, feed her, bathe her, and tuck her in for sleep!
Dress her up in stylish looks! Hats, glasses, collars, new fur colors, and more! Experiment and create your own unique cat!
Play the merge mini-game, compete on the leaderboard, and earn coins!
Watch the best video memes with funny moments from her life!
Complete the daily challenges and come back tomorrow, Komaru will miss you!
Try to unlock all achievements! Come and have fun!

title: Cyber Arrow
description: Play Cyber Arrow – a fast, fun online game where you become a Techno Archer! Fly a remote-controlled arrow, solve puzzles, defeat enemies, and rescue hostages across 3 exciting game modes in a stunning sci-fi world.

title: Hexa Stack
description: Welcome to Hexa Stack—an all-new hexagon puzzle that’s equal parts relaxing and challenging. Sort colorful tiles by color, stack smart to create powerful combos, and think ahead before the board fills up. Each level adds new twists, requiring focus, memory, and clever planning. Stuck? Use boosters like swap and shuffle to keep your run alive. Simple controls, satisfying merges, and nonstop brain fun!

title: Romantic K-Pop Transformation
description: In this game, the stars of K-pop are preparing for a romantic transformation. Create a unique images for girls, full of tenderness and brilliance of the stage. Experiment with makeup; change the hairstyles and hair color of the girls. Choose the perfect outfit: from cute dresses and stylish tops to trendy skirts and trousers. Complete the look with fashion accessories. Compare the resulting images and decide which of the heroines of the game has become the real queen of romantic K-pop style.

title: Tangram Puzzle
description:
Tangram Puzzles is a relaxing geometric logic game where you must recreate a given shape using classic tangram pieces. The challenge trains your spatial thinking, visualization, and ability to rotate and position shapes so they perfectly fit the silhouette.

Don’t be afraid to experiment — sometimes a wrong combination in one place prevents the correct placement somewhere else.

title: Mahjong 3D Match
description: Welcome to the 3D Mahjong adventure! Challenge your mind with speed and precision. Plan your moves, view the board from all angles and remove pieces intelligently. Beat increasingly difficult levels, play offline and relax with immersive music.

title: Theo Morini's Magical Resort
description:
“Theo Morini’s Magical Resort” is a magical, romantic, and captivating merge puzzle game about rebuilding a resort on an enchanted island.

Talented writers and actors created this story and brought its characters to life. Enjoy the story!

title: Car Mechanic Simulator 2025
description:
In "Car Mechanic Simulator 2025", you are a master restorer who breathes new life into forgotten cars! 

Your task is to find old, broken, and abandoned cars, disassemble them down to the last screw, repair them, replace parts, and reassemble them, turning rusty piles of metal into shiny legends of the automotive industry. Search for rare spare parts, restore engines, choose the perfect paint, and bring every detail to perfection.

title: Ludo Star
description: Enter the arena of strategy and chance! Choose your favorite mode, unlock stylish dice skins and climb the trophy road. Outsmart opponents, master your moves and prove you’ve got what it takes to rule the board and become a Ludo Star.

title: Mr Bounce
description: Challenge yourself with Mr Bounce, the brain-boosting puzzle game that will test your thinking skills and reflexes. Each level is a new puzzle demanding strategic planning and precise execution. Mr Bounce is more than just a game; it's a mental workout that improves your cognitive abilities.

title: Koko Loco Block Blast
description: Think fast, blast smart — can you beat your best score? Blast blocks, fit shapes, and outsmart the grid in this fast-paced puzzle challenge! Every move counts: clear space, chain combos, and keep the board from filling up. With smooth controls, colorful blocks, and quick rounds, it’s perfect for casual fun or deep strategy. Easy to pick up, hard to put down — how high can you climb the high score ladder?

title: Cheerful Plumber
description: Greetings, young artist. Do you like video games and creativity? Then this game is for you! Color video game characters: a princess, a cheerful plumber, a dragon and others! Choose different colors on the main and secondary palette. Play and color! Take a screenshot and share the result with your friends!

title: Treasure Hunt Puzzle
description: Explore ruins, complete stone tablet puzzles, and collect treasures! Solve each puzzle by fitting all your blocks into the board using the symbols as hints.

title: Home Block Story
description: Step into a world of renovation! Match blocks, clear the board and unlock new decor to design your house just the way you want. With each new challenge, show your unique style and make your dream home a reality.

title: Gun Shooting Games Sniper 3D
description: Step into the battlefield and test your precision in Gun Shooting Games: Sniper 3D, an exciting fps experience packed with nonstop action. This immersive first person shooting game puts you in the role of an elite sniper armed with powerful weapons and challenging missions.

title: Survival Island: EVO
description: Play a fun adventure and simulation game in Survival Island: EVO. You are alone on a mysterious island, and the challenge begins: survive, build, and thrive. Gather more resources like food, water, wood, and stone. And craft the tools you need to stay alive. Build your shelter, light a fire, and protect yourself from hunger and wild animals. Explore hidden corners of the island, discover secrets, and unlock new crafting recipes. Become the true survivor.

title: Reach 2048
description: The classic 2048 puzzle — slide numbered tiles on a grid, merge them, and reach the legendary 2048 tile! Simple to learn, impossible to put down. Challenge your brain with this addictive number puzzle. Plan your moves carefully, build combos, and aim for the highest score. How far can you go beyond 2048?

title: Twinkle Shooter
description: Shoot at stones of the same color to drop them. They can be cleared when three or more of the same color are matched. If a stone enters the heart, the slot spins for a fever chance! The game is over if the stones reach the bottom.

title: Water Junk Warriors
description: Water Junk Warriors is a vibrant eco-adventure game where players dive into polluted waterways to clean up human-made junk and restore the natural balance of riverbanks, beaches, and urban canals. Armed with clever tools and a passion for nature, players collect floating trash, unlock animated milestones, and witness the environment come back to life, one subgoal at a time.

title: Fish rain 2
description:
"Cast and pull!" is the motto of this fishing game. Everything is real here: the sounds in the locations, and the online chat. Share your legendary trophies with other players, show off your catch, and name the weight and type of fish.

 Try to catch a pike or a catfish, a perch or a minnow, or maybe a carp or a sturgeon?

 Fish in different locations: on a rocky shore or on the Pripyat River. Use a variety of baits, from worms to live bait and leeches.

title: Obby - Escape Barry's jail parkour
description: An incredible escape from the New Barry Prison awaits you! Cool locations, parkour and obby. Show your agility to avoid getting caught by Barry.

title: Murderers VS Sheriffs Duels
description:
Love Roblox-style action games? Get ready for the ultimate showdown!

Jump into fast-paced 1v1, 2v2, 3v3, and 4v4 duels where every second counts. Play as a Murderer or a Sheriff, master unique abilities, and outplay your enemies in style.

If you enjoy games like Murder Mystery or Arsenal in Roblox, this is made for you!

title: Labubu Jetpack Rush
description: Fly high in Jetpack Jump with Labubu to survive the escape from the lab! Tap to use the jetpack and release to run . Upgrade your jetpack, your running speed and other upgrades to be able to travel further than before and beat your high score. The further you travel the more money you get!

title: Packing Line
description: Ship all the cans. Choose a box of the same color as the can. The game is over if you run out of space for boxes and the line stops.

title: Pixel Blast
description: Pixel Blast is a colorful online arcade game that mixes classic gameplay with modern design. Play for free on your phone or computer and enjoy smooth controls and vibrant pixel art. It’s easy to pick up and fun for players of all ages.

title: Connect Em All
description: Play Connect Em All Online and Solve Colorful Dot Puzzles. Connect Em All is an exciting and addictive puzzle game that you can enjoy for free right in your browser. The goal is simple yet surprisingly challenging: connect all the dots of the same color to complete each level. It sounds easy at first, but as the puzzles grow in size and complexity, you will need clever thinking and careful planning to succeed.

title: Merge Blocks 2048
description: Swipe to slide numbered tiles on a 4x4 grid. Match two identical blocks to merge them into a bigger number. Start from 2 and work your way up to 2048 and beyond. The board fills up with every move so plan ahead. Chain multiple merges in a row to build combos and earn bonus coins. Spend coins in the shop on power-ups like Undo, Extra Life, Score Boost, Shuffle and Head Start. Beat your high score and try to reach the highest tile possible. Easy to learn, hard to master.

title: Guinea Piggy Matching
description:
Guinea Piggy Match uses well known and easy to learn game mechanics. Your target is to take apart a pattern made of tiles. 
For each completed level, you are given a golden puzzle piece. For these, you can uncover images of cute guinea piggies.

title: Queens Royal: Sudoku Puzzle
description: Queens Royal: Sudoku Puzzle reimagines the classic eight queens challenge into a sleek logic game with over 5,000 levels. Place queens strategically so none share a row, column, or color zone while avoiding attacks in all directions. With elegant visuals, daily challenges, endless mode, and smart hints, every puzzle offers a unique test of reasoning and precision for players who enjoy refined brain-teasers.

title: Goods Sorting Shopping Master
description: In Goods Sorting Shopping Master, you organize messy goods by moving and matching them into neat groups. It’s a fun puzzle game that combines smart thinking with relaxing gameplay. In the game, you’ll face shelves filled with mixed goods such as drinks, snacks, and daily items. Match and sort three identical items to clear the space and proceed, based on the customer's needs. Manage space carefully to keep sorting.

title: Wordling: Daily Word Challenge
description: Wordling is a fun, free daily word puzzle game where you guess the hidden word in 6 tries using color-coded clues. Perfect for adults and seniors who love brain games, spelling challenges, and relaxing, ad-free gameplay. Explore all game modes!

title: Flower Block
description: Dive into our unique COMBO gameplay, where you strategically place blocks to clear rows or columns. Watch as clearing multiple lines triggers exciting animations and earns you bonus points. Challenge your mind and plan your moves wisely to ace Flower Block!

title: Fluffy Mania
description: Step into the charming world of Fluffy Mania, where bright, fluffy creatures are ready to test your puzzle-solving skills. This online game combines adorable visuals with clever gameplay, creating a fun and relaxing challenge. Play on desktop or mobile and dive into colorful levels full of lovable characters. Connect matching creatures, score points, and climb through progressively tricky stages.

title: Squid Game Hunter
description: Step into the thrilling world of Squid Game – a fast-paced game for stealthy and strategic players that takes you on a wild adventure as a hunter with a deadly knife. With multiple Squid games enemies to kill, challenging missions to complete, and rewards to collect, this game will test your skills and keep you on the edge of your seat.

title: Phantom thief Cat Running
description: Avoid obstacles and reach the goal! Tap to change direction, and the game ends when your stamina reaches zero. Pick up items to increase your score or restore stamina. Collect three stars to enter Invincible Mode. Fish bones reduce stamina, but collecting ten turns coins into high-scoring diamonds for a short time!

title: Arrow Puzzle
description: Arrow Puzzle is a relaxing logic game that turns simple taps into a rewarding challenge. Your goal is straightforward: find a free path, tap arrows in the right order, and enjoy as the maze slowly turns into a clear, empty board. Follow the arrows to escape the puzzle and find a soothing flow that keeps your mind engaged and relaxed.

title: 12-in-1 Solitaire
description:
Solitaire is one of the most popular – if not the most popular – card games in the world! Experience premium Solitaire gameplay at its best with 12 of the world's most popular Solitaire games!

Welcome to our latest & most comprehensive collection of the world's best & most popular Solitaire games! We included 12 of the most beloved Solitaire games in 1 comphrehensive collection, added helpful features appreciated by both Solitaire pros and amateurs alike.

title: Math Master
description: Unleash your inner math whiz! Math Master turns numbers into art—solve fun math problems to unlock drawing tools, sketch colorful shapes, and bring numerical puzzles to life. Perfect for learners and creativity lovers alike!

title: GenFire
description:
GenFire is a fast-paced top-down survival shooter where players fight endless waves of enemies in intense 360° combat.

Survive increasingly difficult levels, defeat elemental creatures, and collect coins while mastering your strategy.

Features:
- 20 handcrafted levels across multiple chapters
- Unique enemy mechanics including splitting fire slimes and bosses
- Skill-based gameplay with increasing difficulty

title: Archers Ragdoll Physics
description: Archers Ragdoll Physics is a physics-based archery action game where ragdoll characters fight using special arrows. The game features 10 characters and 12 unique arrows such as lightning, fire, poison, missile, and rocket. Players can equip three arrows and switch between them during battles. Some levels include traps like electric cables and spinning gears that can be activated with arrows. In 2 Player Mode, players choose from 7 arrows and compete to hit their opponent the most.

title: Earth Defender
description:
Earth Defender is a fast-paced arcade game where you control a spaceship orbiting around planet Earth. Deadly meteors are flying toward the planet, and it's your mission to stop them before they crash into Earth.

Your ship circles the planet. Time your moves carefully and collide with incoming meteors to destroy them

Tap to change your orbit direction and intercept as many meteors as possible. Survive the meteor storm and defend Earth for as long as you can!

title: Grow a Garden 3D
description:
Welcome to Grow a Garden, a fun and peaceful game where you plant seeds and grow magical trees! ?
Explore different seasons, customize your character, and watch your garden grow bigger every day.
Every seed is special and every garden is unique!

title: Darling Doll
description: Darling Doll is the ultimate paper doll DIY game that offers a perfect blend of character creation and dress-up game. With a vast collection of outfits, accessories, and hairstyles, you can unleash your creativity and design unique avatars that reflect your personal style. Whether you prefer chibi dolls or glamorous fashion dolls, Darling Doll has got you covered.

title: Travel Story Match
description: Embark on a global adventure with Travel Story Match! Match 3 identical travel items to complete exciting puzzles. Use powerful boosters to tackle tricky combinations, explore iconic destinations, and uncover hidden gems. Complete Daily Missions and Weekly Challenges, collect rewards, and enjoy hundreds of thrilling levels. Start your journey now and create your very own unforgettable travel story!

title: SNAKES
description: SNAKES is a modern puzzle game that combines strategy and spatial reasoning. Players guide multiple snakes across a grid, filling every empty tile to complete each level. With clear visuals and intuitive mechanics, the game offers a relaxing yet challenging experience that sharpens logical thinking. Each level introduces unique layouts and obstacles, ensuring variety and depth as players advance.

title: Pim Path
description:
Reach the trophy at the end of the level to win, but it's not as easy as it might seem. You can't fall off the platforms; spikes and blades will be everywhere, making the levels more challenging. One wrong step and it's game over.
You'll need to stay calm, pay attention, be agile, have good reflexes, and most importantly, don't get angry.

title: Underwater Survival
description:
Dive Into a Mysterious and Beautiful Underwater World
Welcome to an unforgettable underwater survival adventure where exploration, discovery, and survival come together in a stunning ocean environment. Dive deep into a vibrant and mysterious sea filled with hidden secrets, breathtaking visuals, and endless possibilities.

title: Pottery Master
description: Pottery Master invites you into a peaceful world of creativity and clay. Shape, sculpt, and refine your pottery using intuitive tools, then add your personal touch with vibrant colors. Each creation is a moment to unwind, express your style, and transform simple clay into a stunning masterpiece in a relaxing, artistic flow

title: Magic and Wizards Mahjong
description: Enter the enchanting world of Magic & Wizards Mahjong! Match mystical tiles adorned with runes, potions, and magical artifacts across beautifully crafted layouts. Enjoy smooth gameplay with boosters like Hint, Shuffle, Undo, Torch, and Freeze. Race against the clock to earn time bonuses, or use extra seconds to finish your quest. With 50 rotating layouts and stunning wizardly visuals, every match feels like a spellbinding adventure for Mahjong lovers and casual players alike.

title: Park Me: Draw Path
description: "Park Me: Draw Path" is a casual puzzle game integrating "painting + parking + puzzle solving", which adds "drawing lines" to the traditional parking gameplay, testing the player's logical thinking, spatial imagination and path planning ability, and getting an "intellectual exercise" in a short period of time.

title: SuperPixelint
description:
It's a game where you draw a cute little image.
You can develop color matching skills and accuracy without any burden.
Why don't you get out of your daily life for a while and heal yourself through coloring games?

title: Katana
description:
It's a first-person Katana game!
Slice all the enemy ninjas into small pieces and save the hostages. Use multiple katana swords and shurikens. Fight epic bosses and complete the levels.

title: AOD - Art Of Defense
description: Step into the world of AOD - Art Of Defense, a free online strategy game where your main goal is to stop enemy waves by placing towers in smart locations. Play on your phone or computer and test your skills in this action-packed defense challenge. Every move matters—can you build the perfect defense?

title: Soccer Duel
description: An exciting game in the style of table football, which you can play both alone and with friends on the same device or over the network.

title: Labuba Halloween Infestation
description: Monsters are invading Halloween! You must destroy them all — the fate of Halloween is in your hands. The game features three different modes, each with tougher and more powerful monsters.

title: Dalgona Game2
description:
There's a cute shape on the dalgona, a snack from the past.
Be careful not to break the shape.
It's complete if you take it out nicely in a pretty way to go!

title: Minicraft Chef Cake Wars
description: Hey player, would you like to have a cooking competition with your friend? In this cooking contest, you must beat your friend. Collect all the cooking materials as quickly as possible. We need to gather the cake ingredients floating in balloons in the air. The player who collects the most ingredients the fastest wins the game. To bake the cake, collect everything: salt, flour, and milk. Gather all the ingredients and win the game!

title: Association - Connect Word
description: Dive into the world of word puzzles and associations! In this game, you need to find hidden connections between words and group them logically. Each level offers new themes, new words, and increasingly challenging tasks. The game develops thinking, expands vocabulary, and trains attention. Intuition and logic will help you complete dozens of levels, from easy to hard, and become a true master of associations. Play at your own pace without time limits and use hints if needed.

title: Grunge Chic Alt Fashion
description:
Step into the edgy world of Grunge Chic Alt Fashion, where style meets attitude. This dress-up game lets you explore the perfect mix of grunge edge and chic sophistication.

From plaid skirts and ripped jeans to oversized jackets, fishnets, and combat boots—you’ll have endless options to design your alternative fashion star. Top it off with smoky makeup, bold lipstick, and layered accessories to complete the vibe.

title: Speedrun platformer
description: A classic platformer with coin collection and jumping on monsters' heads. But if you complete the levels as quickly as possible, you can get into the leaderboard.

title: Sworded.io - Spin and Rub.
description: Test your skills in the game – an arcade simulator of sword fights! Fight waves of enemies, upgrade your character, unlock powerful weapons and magic spells. Demonstrate your tactics and reaction in dynamic battles!

title: Pull The Pins
description: Pull the Pins is a strategic puzzle game where you must carefully pull pins in the correct order to rescue a young boy and make him reach his brother. Each decision matters, as a wrong move could lead to failure. Plan your actions wisely and use problem-solving skills to ensure a successful rescue.

title: Horror School Detective Story
description: Ready to enter a horror school full of scares and mysteries? In Horror School: Detective Story, you’ll play the role of a brave detective. Solve the mysteries layered on top of each other at the school. Each scene is tense and exciting, full of suspense and the unknown! Choose the complexity of the scenario to start your challenge.

title: Space Shift
description: It's a game where you travel in space for as long as possible without hitting any obstacles- meteorites or missiles. Your ship moves automatically and you can slow it down to ensure it doesn't hit anything. There are different galaxies to travel through different in appearance and the type of obstacles to appear. If you travel far enough, you may encounter even an alien ship!

title: Skillful Finger
description: Touch the screen and slide your finger along the glowing line without lifting it. Avoid barriers, stay clear of the edges, and react quickly as the speed increases. Customize your ball and tail, face dynamic obstacles, and enjoy endlessly generated paths that keep every run fast, challenging, and addictive.

title: Doomsday Tower Defense
description:
Survive the zombie apocalypse in this fast-paced 2D top-down tower defense game. Construct and upgrade various defensive turrets to take down hordes of undead attackers.

Earn coins by killing zombies and use them to purchase new towers, upgrade existing ones, or sell for cash and reinvest into a different turret.

Defend your base from waves of shambling corpses as you fight to stay alive in a world gone mad.

title: Block Builder Jam
description: Block Builder Jam is a physics-based puzzle game that blends logic with creativity. Your goal is to drop blocks and fit them into the outlined shape on the screen. Each block falls according to real physics, so precision and timing matter. As levels progress, shapes become more complex and demand sharper planning. With its simple mechanics and engaging challenges, Block Builder Jam offers a satisfying mix of strategy and experimentation.

title: Obby Prison Run
description: Obby Prison Run is an intense obstacle course game where escape is the only option—and survival is everything. Sprint, leap, and dodge through deadly traps and twisted takes on classic childhood games. Outsmart your rivals and stay ahead in the race for freedom, where every second counts and only the sharpest make it out alive.

title: Bloons Survival.io
description:
Bloons Survival. io is a fast-paced survival arcade game where you fight off endless waves of balloons!

Control your monkey hero, throw darts automatically, and pop incoming enemies before they get too close.
Collect coins and power-ups to grow stronger, but stay alert — one hit can end your run!

How long can you survive?

title: Squid Game Memory Card Match
description:
Step into the thrilling world of Squid Game Memory Card Match! Test your memory and focus as you uncover pairs of iconic Squid Game symbols and characters. Can you keep your cool under pressure and match all the cards before time runs out?
Challenge yourself or compete with friends to see who can master the ultimate memory test. With Squid Game Memory Card Match, every flip brings you closer to victory or defeat – can you handle the pressure?

title: Sweet Dessert Hole
description: Ready to make cute and tasty desserts? In Sweet Dessert Hole, you control a hole that sucks up various sweet toppings. Move the hole around to collect chocolate, cream, fruits, cookies, dan many more. Collect everything on the base before time runs out. Use your coins to upgrade the hole and make the gameplay faster and easier. After making one or more cakes, you can arrange them neatly on a tray. This game is simple, relaxing, and very satisfying to play.

title: Jigsaw Cards: Daily Puzzles
description:
Jigsaw Cards: Daily Puzzles is a relaxing jigsaw-style puzzle game where you assemble beautiful images piece by piece. Enjoy a calming experience as each picture comes to life under your fingertips!
Who It's For
Ideal for puzzle lovers, casual players, and anyone who enjoys peaceful, visually pleasing gameplay.
Start assembling now with Jigsaw Cards: Daily Puzzles — discover a cozy world of delightful puzzles!

title: Rabbit & Carrot
description: Help the rabbit collect all of the carrots on each level and get to the flag. Lots of spikes and spiky enemies to avoid. Open gates and use bubbles to float across the screen. 48 challenging levels in this fun platformer.

title: Vikings: An Archer's Journey
description: Vikings: An Archer’s Journey blends the fast-paced action of a shoot ’em up with the adrenaline rush of an infinite runner, all presented in a striking minimalist art style. Play as Nott, a fearless Valkyrie archer, on a quest to save her wolf, Oder, from the Underworld. Use intuitive controls, collect powerful upgrades, and team up with Viking heroes to face off against mythical Nordic creatures in this thrilling adventure.

title: Office Brawl - Room Smash
description:
Become the hero of an office rebellion and destroy everything in your path! The player will have to transform into a disgruntled employee who challenges the system, destroys obstacles and fights the boss.

Use brute force and ingenuity to get through difficult tests, participate in intense battles and explosive actions.
Become an antihero and sow chaos from start to finish!

title: Cop Simulator
description: Cop Simulator is an exciting and dynamic gaming experience that immerses you in the world of a lawman with unlimited possibilities. In this game you will take on the role of a cop, where you are given complete freedom of action.

title: Counter Craft Sniper
description: Counter Craft Sniper is a first-person shooter where you step into the boots of an elite sniper sent to protect a city invaded by Minecraft mobs. Creepers, skeletons, and zombies have appeared in the middle of downtown, and only your precision and quick reflexes can stop them before the chaos spreads. Armed with your trusty sniper rifle, you must take position on rooftops and high vantage points to eliminate every hostile target that threatens the civilians below.

title: Pool 8
description: Pool 8 is a relaxing yet challenging billiards-style puzzle game where players must sink all the balls into the pockets in the correct order. The game follows a step-by-step movement system, requiring strategic planning to clear the table efficiently. With smooth mechanics and progressively difficult levels, Pool 8 offers a unique twist on classic pool gameplay, perfect for puzzle and strategy lovers.

title: Chess Online
description:
Options:
- Choose an opponent from 18 difficulty levels from Beginner to World Champion
- Selection of time control modes: Unlimited, Bullet, Blitz, Rapid, Classic
- Highlighting possible moves when choosing a piece
- Cancel the move, if there was a yawn, you can go back
- Interactive hints, showing the best move during the game
- Analysis after the game, highlights mistakes and gives recommendations on how to play
- Replay the game from the right place
- Setting the handicap

title: Ragdoll Bounce
description: Jump into a fun 2D challenge where you control a ragdoll launched by a bigger ragdoll. Click to bounce on platforms and keep climbing. But be careful—missing a platform means a big fall!

title: Lovie Chic's Coachella Festival
description: Step into the vibrant world of Lovie Chic’s Coachella Festival, the ultimate festival dress-up game! Style your character with trendy outfits, accessories, and makeup to shine at the iconic Coachella Festival. With simple controls and endless creativity, Lovie Chic’s Coachella Festival is perfect for quick fun or long gaming sessions.

title: Last Standing
description: Players are dropped onto a map and start without weapons. The map is scattered with a wealth of weapons and equipment. Players need to constantly explore and collect these resources to enhance their survival ability and combat power. The core goal of the game is to be the last survivor. Usually, there are multiple players in each game, and they are randomly distributed on the map.

title: The White Room 4
description: The White Room 4 is an immersive escape game that challenges your logic and problem-solving skills. Find yourself trapped in a hotel room and embark on a thrilling adventure to escape. Utilize the tools at your disposal, solve intricate puzzles, uncover hidden clues, and crack passwords to unlock your path to freedom. Will you be able to conquer the puzzles and break free from this challenging escape experience?

title: Truck Stack Colors
description: Get ready for an exciting challenge. Truck Stack Colors takes you into a wonderful world of parkour and truck stacking. In attractive levels, advance by stacking platforms that are the same color as the truck. To master the balancing and stacking skills to build amazing truck towers and climb even higher.

title: Monkey Bubble Defense
description:
Survive the bubble invasion in this fast-paced 2D top-down tower defense game. Construct and upgrade various defensive turrets to take down hordes of bubbles.

Earn cash by popping bubbles. Use cash to to purchase new towers, upgrade existing ones, or sell for cash and reinvest into a different turret.

title: Cowboys Duel
description: In this fast-paced cowboy showdown, players can either compete solo or engage in a thrilling duel against a friend, testing their reflexes and quick draw skills. Will you answer the call to become the fastest and most skilled cowboy around?

title: Color Dots Challenge
description: Dive into Color Dots Challenge, a bright and addictive puzzle game that puts your logic and strategy to the test. Connect, match, and move colorful dots to clear the board and score big! Simple to play yet hard to master, this free online game is perfect for quick breaks or long sessions on your phone or computer. Can you outsmart the colors and conquer every level?

title: Merge Galaxy
description:
The famous merge game is arrived!
You can shoot the planets like balls to throw, and when the same planets touch each other, it becomes bigger planet!
Cute planets want to be bigger, so keep merge the planets until you make the sun!

title: Break a Lucky Egg Brainrots
description: Break a Lucky Egg Brainrots is a fast and rewarding collection game where action, risk, and strategy come together. Your mission is to break brainrot eggs, collect rare Brainrot characters, and safely deliver them to your base before time runs out. Each run is a mix of decision making and reflex.

title: Color Mix - Jelly Merge
description: This is an enthralling puzzle game with jellies. Dive into the world of exciting puzzles! Match jellies of the same color to reach new heights and beat high scores. With each level, the challenges get tougher and the fun gets bigger.

title: Pixel Flow
description: Come to train your brain with colors and paths. Pixel Flow is a clean and addictive pixel puzzle game that challenges your logic and planning skills. In each level, you must send kittens of different colors into the track. Pixel points matching the kittens' colors will be eliminated. Paths cannot cross or overlap, so every move matters.

title: Fruit Jam
description:
Make juice from fresh fruits in this easy and enjoyable Match-3 puzzle game!
Click on the fruit, if the fruit and the cup are the same color, just squeeze it.

title: Jello Bubbles
description: Classic Match 3 Bubble Shooter Game with jello balls, challenges, a nice bird and a fantastic heroine. Enjoy with lots of fun levels travelling around the world.

title: Aliens Hunter
description: You are an alien hunter and your mission is to use your abilities to find the aliens hidden in the city and use your gun to accurately shoot the aliens to get rewards. Each round has different aliens hiding in different locations. You have to accurately choose, aim and shoot to complete the level mission.

title: Elytra Flight
description: Elytra Flight is an endless flying adventure inspired by the legendary Elytra wings. Players take to the skies in a fast-paced challenge where reflexes and strategy decide how long they can survive. Whether solo or in 2 player mode, the game blends arcade action with survival mechanics, offering a fresh and rewarding experience every flight.

title: Puzzle Blocks Asmr Match
description:
Puzzle Blocks ASMR Match is a block puzzle game that combines classics with innovation. It is different from the block jigsaw games and brick puzzle games you usually play. This game uses a
real physics engine. After the bottom blocks are eliminated, the upper bricks will automatically fall down, which makes the game more difficult. In the game, you cannot rotate the blocks to make
them fit more gaps, which means that you often only have one chance.

title: Tag Run
description: Tag Run is an adrenaline-fueled multiplayer action parkour game where 1–4 local players race to ditch the bomb and be the last standing! Tag opponents, use teleport pads and jump springs, and survive thrilling matches with 6 players. Explore six dynamic maps: Pixel, Winter, Lava, Jungle, Candy, and Night, and packed with creative power-ups. Test your reflexes, strategy, and parkour skills in this fast-paced, chaotic playground challenge.

title: Bow And Arrow
description:
? Bow and Arrow – Master Your Archery Skills! ?

Step into the world of precision shooting in Bow and Arrow! Test your skills, aim with accuracy, and hit your targets in a variety of exciting levels. Whether you're shooting at moving targets, battling enemies, or competing in archery challenges, this game will put your skills to the test!

title: Stack Fall
description:
Smash the floor! 
Are you under stress? Maybe Stack Fall can help you to release the stress. 
As your ball keep breaking the floors to get to the goal, every smashing will ease your stress. 
It's time to break some stacks!

title: Fitness Club 3D
description: Fitness Club 3D is a casual game where you plunge into the world of fitness and make every workout count as you strive to build an empire. Help your clients achieve their dream bodies and fitness aspirations while transforming your studio into the ultimate gym. Jump into the aerobics class, making a splash to rake in the cash. Pay close attention to your clients' forms, ensuring proper training techniques.

title: Train Master
description: All aboard for an exciting ride in Train Master! Tap and hold to control your train, race through stunning tracks, pick up passengers, and dodge obstacles. Navigate bustling cities and peaceful countryside as you master the tracks, upgrade your train, and become the ultimate conductor. Simple controls, thrilling challenges, and endless fun await. Start your adventure now!

title: Shell Strikers
description:
Shell Strikers is an exciting turn-based artillery combat game where strategy meets action. Lead your team of soldiers in intense battles across diverse battlefields including war-torn cities, scorching deserts, and peaceful meadows.

Each turn, you must carefully aim your shots, account for wind conditions, and choose the right weapon from your arsenal. Available weapons include rockets, bombs, laser guns, airstrikes, and dynamite - each with unique properties and limited ammo.

title: Ragdoll Show: Throw, Break and Destroy!
description: Dive into the chaotic fun of ragdoll mayhem! Navigate thrilling challenges by guiding your ragdoll character through each level, leveraging realistic physics for epic destruction. Sharpen your skills and unleash maximum chaos—can you conquer every challenge and emerge victorious?

title: Mafia Sniper Crime Shooting
description: Ready to become the coldest, deadliest sniper in the entire city? Mafia Sniper Crime Shooting is a FPS action shooting simulator where you complete high-risk missions. Use powerful guns to eliminate dangerous mafia targets.

title: Emoji Smasher - Smiley Game
description:
Emoji Smasher is a Hyper Casual game to make you smile while playing!
Guess the emoticon expressions in this fast-paced challenge! Tap on emojis and win this lively, emoji-filled adventure.

title: Black Hole: Beauty Makeup
description: Black Hole: Beauty Makeup is a game where the player controls a black hole trying to devour as many objects around it as possible. Eat more, grow more, then create a beauty makeover!  Cool black hole simulator. Absorb different objects. Unlock skins. Do you like black hole and simulators?

title: Crocodilo Tralalero Run
description: Crocodilo Tralalero Run is a fast-paced platformer where your Crazy fiends runs forward automatically, and you must jump, dodge obstacles, defeat enemies, and collect coins. Unlock and customize your Crazy fiends in the shop to enhance your adventure. With its exciting gameplay and charming rewards, Crocodilo, Tralalero, Tsung Tsung and others characters offers fun for all ages!

title: Strawberry Hero
description: Stick your fork and climb to the top! Hold down to keep sticking the fork continuously. If your fork hits a hero or an obstacle, it’s game over! Stick the fork just above the falling hero’s feet to trigger a Super Jump and earn a high score!

title: Timewalker: Survive!
description: Time Walker: Survive – Embark on a thrilling journey through apocalyptic landscapes in this fast-paced 2D top-down survival game! As a Timewalker, battle relentless hordes of zombies across different eras, fighting for survival against increasingly intense waves of the undead.

title: Russian Checkers
description:
Russian Checkers with computer, Online with real people or Together on same screen.
Game Modes:
- With a computer
- Online
- Online with a friend via the link
- Together on the same screen

title: Rocket Sky!
description: In Rocket Sky! you tap and hold the screen to launch your rocket as far into the sky as you can. Make sure not to overheat though, otherwise it’s game over!

title: Chicken Math
description: I am Archimedes. I've been trying to solve this difficult problem for a week, and those chickens have stolen my numbers again. Grab the rifle and head to the backyard. Find and retrieve my numbers. Just be careful — I need the correct numbers!

title: Wednesday Light Academia
description: Join the trend in Wednesday Light Academia - a fun, immersive makeover game for girls! Today you're becoming a super-talented stylist and your job is to transform Wednesday Addams from a dark e-girl look to a stunning girly-girl fashionista. Explore the fun realms of makeup, hairstyling, and fashion-forward wardrobe choices with this addictive game. Have fun!

title: Bloom Within: A life simulator
description:
The simulator of a pregnant mother allows you to fully experience the whole process of pregnancy.
In this anime game you have to play the role of a girl who has a loving husband and a child under her heart, who is waiting for her birth. Take care of yourself, give birth, take care of your baby and raise a healthy baby.

title: Plant Merge: Zombie War
description: In the chaotic world of Merge Plant Zombie War, arm your garden with strategic merges to fend off relentless zombie hordes! Master upgrades, deploy special abilities, and outsmart waves of undead foes in this addictive merge-tower defense adventure. Will your botanical army prevail in the ultimate war for survival? Dive in and merge your way to victory!

title: Cat Cut
description: A fun game about a hungry cat, get him a fish, cut the rope so that it falls directly to the cat. All objects move according to physics, do not miss the fish, do not upset the cat!

title: Obby Champions
description: A journey awaits you where every wall is a challenge, every obstacle is an ancient seal, and every punch is a step towards legend. Explore unique zones, fight titans, and find rare pets with unique abilities. Enter hidden codes, collect fragments of history, and leave your mark in the Hall of Echoes - only the strongest will be able to break all the seals and become the Fist of Legends!

title: Hide and Escape from Angry Teacher
description: Dive into the atmosphere of escape with hide and seek in this free online 3d game! Help the hero to escape school! Hide and interact with objects to avoid being seen by the teachers. Get to the school bus by any means necessary to escape!

title: ASMR Pet Treatment
description: Take care of your adorable puppy and kitty in this relaxing ASMR game! Wash, heal, and pamper your pets with gentle treatments. After they feel happy and healthy, have fun dressing them up in cute outfits. Relaxing sounds and sweet pets make every moment enjoyable!

title: Color It in 3D
description:
Meet the best 3D coloring book!
Relax, immerse yourself in creativity and get inspired!
Draw and create fantasy, cartoon, funny and anime action figures!
If you like 3D character designs, drawing, coloring, then this coloring book is for you.

title: Stickman vs Zombies WorldCraft
description:
Stickman vs Zombies WorldCraft is an action and adventure platform game in which you can play as a brave stick ninja. As your stickman hero, your mission is to wipe all the craft zombies. Along the way, you'll find money that you may use to unlock cool new skins.

Navigate the map in search of zombies before they track you down and rush you or open fire on you. Keep going, for the zombie craft will attempt to catch you if you leave even one alive.

title: Sorcerer Mahjong Marvels
description: Step into the Sorcerer Mahjong Marvels. Match mystical tiles adorned with enchanting artifacts. Collect only open tiles that don't have adjacent tiles to the left or right. Gather all the tile sets to win each level. Conquer 60 levels within the time limits to complete this game. Uncover magical secrets to become the ultimate magician!

title: Hotfoot Baseball
description:
Simple baseball game with fun, cartoony players and easy one-click controls. It’s fast to learn and fun to play!

Unlike other baseball games, the action doesn’t stop after you hit the ball. You need to decide when to run, move to the next base, and try to score runs. It’s all about timing and quick decisions.

Pick one of the best baseball countries and try to win the championship. The game keeps the excitement of baseball but with simple rules, so anyone can enjoy it.

title: Bitball
description:
A unique tile ball puzzle game from coin base bitcoin games loved by millions of players around the world. 
Make a lot of coins and become a rich. ?
 - Start with 10 and start making millions. ?
 - Coun you rech the topmillioners.❓
 - Play with friend together.?
 - Guess the ball where it will go.?

title: Cargo Skates
description:
No obstacles, no matter how high, can stop me from collecting more goods.
Pass the obstacles and finally collect enough goods.
Now, your supermarket can open

title: Robbotto
description: Robbotto is an arcade platformer with a retro esthetic. Play alone or with a friend as you travel through the ship defeating all the enemies.

title: Bull Runner
description: Take control of a powerful bull as it charges forward at full speed! Smash through obstacles, knock over stickmen, and leave destruction in your wake. How far can you go before something stops you? Test your reflexes and unleash the unstoppable force of the raging bull!

title: Soccer Tournament
description: Soccer Tournament is a fun and fast-paced tabletop-style soccer game where you control a team of caps, flicking them to pass, shoot, and score goals. Strategize your moves, outplay your opponent, and aim for victory in this exciting, skill-based challenge!

title: Zombie Rush
description:
Zombies Rush is a fast-paced top-down survival shooter that pits a lone survivor against an endless, evolving horde. Built for fluid action, this 2D arcade shooter, turns every escape into a high-stakes dance with death.
Tilt and weave through trees to outmaneuver the rush.
Each wave brings faster, smarter, and deadlier undead threats.
Experience a modern take on the classic zombie survival genre with clean, stylized graphics and kinetic combat.

title: Headleg Dash Parkour
description: Touch controls have never been easier and more accurate! Run, jump, and climb walls just by tapping anywhere on. Pass the obstacles and raise the flag to complete the level. Difficult levels will make you addicted and feel challenged. complete all levels and try to unlock cute and cool skins

title: Obstacle Car Driving
description:
Obstacle Car Driving is an exciting and challenging endless driving game where precision and reflexes are key! Navigate through four unique environments, each packed with unpredictable obstacles that will test your driving skills.
Choose from four different cars, each with its own handling and performance, and collect in-game currency as you drive. Use your earnings to unlock new vehicles and themes

title: Snowflight
description: In this game, you control the flight of a bird, exploring snowy landscapes and enjoying the winter atmosphere. Various game modes await you: explore the world, search for hidden items, and take part in thrilling competitions. Each mode offers unique challenges, allowing you to test yourself in different aspects of the game and create unforgettable experiences.

title: BFFs Y2K Fashion
description: Welcome to BFFs Y2K Fashion, the exciting new fashion designer game that lets you explore the trend of the year 2000! With a wide selection of styles from the decade, you can create the perfect look and express your fashion sense. From skater girl skirts to ripped jeans and t-shirts, or even the classic Y2K look with fun-colored low-waisted jeans and crop tops, you can customize your outfit and become an ultimate fashion designer. Play now and let your style shine!

title: Triangles
description:
If you like to organize your thoughts while playing, then "Triangles" is the game for you.
Combine, connect and match blocks in this exciting challenge that will test your logic skills. This king of puzzles will train your brain and help develop your logic and mental abilities. Don't let the shapes fill the hex grid!
The game will be interesting to fans of games with blocks.

title: NinjaRoof
description: NinjaRoof is a fast-paced and addictive arcade game where players control a nimble character jumping from rooftop to rooftop while avoiding deadly obstacles and aiming for the highest score. Test your timing, precision, and reflexes in this endless jumping adventure built with smooth physics and clean visuals.

title: Fight for the Tree
description:
The gaming world is facing a serious tree crisis. Evil forces are running wild, and the trees are in great danger.
As a player, your mission is to protect these precious trees. Even when you're offline, your character will keep fighting to safeguard the trees, constantly accumulating experience and resources.
In the game, there's also a group of cute little sapling creatures imprisoned by the evil forces. You need to rescue them one by one through battles, explorations, and so on.

title: Catch The Pig
description: This is a casual elimination game. The main purpose of the game is to find three identical pigs, catch them, and collect all the pig collections!

title: Coin Stack Up
description:
Coin Stack Up is a colorful and satisfying puzzle game where strategy meets stacking fun!
Connect and stack coins of the same color to create powerful combinations and clear the board.
To make a valid move, you must connect at least 3 coins of the same color. The bigger the stack, the better the results! Each level comes with specific goals shown at the top of the screen - plan your moves carefully to complete them before you run out of moves.

title: Fishing Life
description: Fishing Life—a relaxing clicker game with 2D cartoon visuals. Choose your target fish, click the water to reel it in, and manage its energy. Prioritize upgrading Strength first. Skins enhance tap strength, outfits boost damage, and Keepnet nets extra prices. Assistants increase Income, Strength, Damage, and Price. Open chests and claim cash from charged drift bottles. Luck might grant you treasure chests—open them for valuable assistants!

title: Table Tennis Open
description: Discover a casual, easy-to-play game for hours of endless fun. Face off against your opponent, bounce the ball as its speed increases, and aim for the highest score. Earn coins with each hit to upgrade your racket!

title: Knife Up 3D
description: Knife Up 3D is a casual game that tests your reflexes. Feel the rhythm, don't damage the ball and beat your opponents. You can unlock new skins with the rewards you get by passing the levels. It's time to test your reflexes, so if you find it interesting, don't forget to share it with your friends and join in! Have fun!

title: Supermarket Sort N Match
description: In 'Supermarket Sort n Match,' rearrange items between shelves to match 3 identical items on one shelf, clearing it and allowing upper shelves to slide down. Clear entire stacks to shift adjacent shelves. Collect all items before time runs out as difficulty increases with each level. Enjoy the ultimate item-sorting and matching challenge!

title: Dino Egg Shooter
description:
Dino Egg Shooter is a fun and addictive puzzle game set in a colorful prehistoric world.
With 100 levels of increasing difficulty, players aim and shoot colorful dino eggs to clear the board. 
Each level presents unique challenges, from tricky formations to limited shots.
Easy controls and charming visuals make Dino Egg Shooter perfect for all ages.
So, get ready

title: Bus Collect
description: The aim of the Bus Collect game is to collect the passengers waiting on the road by making the right directions and deliver them to the finish point. To do this, direct the roads the vehicle will follow with arrow signs. Try to reach high scores by carrying as many passengers as possible to the finish point.

title: Obby Survive Parkour
description:
Obby Survivor Parkour is a fast-paced 3D parkour and escape game designed for players who trust their reflexes. You will test both your speed and balance skills while trying to survive in the obstacle filled course!

Each section is full of new traps and platforms that will challenge you even more. Try to survive tsunami waves, obstacle courses, lava attacks, snowball storms and red light green light game and reach the finish line.  Can you be one of the few who can reach the end of the course?

title: Bubble Shooter GO
description:
Pop. Match. Dominate.
Step into the world of precision and strategy with the ultimate bubble shooter experience.

Solo Mode – Play at your own pace or push your skills to the limit. Chain powerful combos, unlock boosters, and master every level as you progress through increasingly challenging stages.

1v1 Battles – Challenge a friend or face off against opponents. Use smart angles, fast reflexes, and well-timed power-ups to outplay your rival in intense bubble duels.

title: Mermaids Spot The Differences
description: Dive into an enchanting underwater world with "Mermaids: Spot The Differences"! Explore vibrant ocean scenes teeming with mermaids and sea creatures as you sharpen your observation skills to uncover subtle distinctions. Immerse yourself in the magic of the deep blue and embark on an adventure of keen-eyed discovery!

title: Cube Connect
description: Move the blocks and guide the ball to the goal. After a period of time, the ball starts to move. Connect the paths quickly so that the ball doesn't fall. Some blocks can jump and some can warp.

title: Turret Gunner
description:
You will find yourself in a thrilling air battle simulation, filled with exciting moments and countless enemy targets. You’ll be able to maneuver, shoot, and fight virtual opponents, experiencing the true adrenaline rush of an airstrike.

This captivating journey into the world of aviation will leave unforgettable impressions on fans of extreme action and flying. Feel like a real pilot and enjoy the excitement of aerial combat!

title: Quackventure
description: Join Quack, the brave duck, on an exhilarating journey through a magical forest brimming with wonder and hidden secrets. Explore enchanting landscapes, solve intriguing mysteries, and embark on an adventure filled with thrilling surprises and endless excitement at every corner!

title: Strike Breakout
description: Strike Breakout is an intense rescue mission game where you're part of a specialized team sent to save the President and his security officers. You ride shotgun with a skilled helicopter pilot as you embark on a series of 10 nail-biting missions. Each mission drops you into enemy territory where you must stealthily navigate through enemy defenses, neutralize threats, and rescue the hostages.

title: Stickman Jailbreak Story
description:
An exciting puzzle game in which the player will have to help stick make a daring escape from prison. Stick found himself in a sinister prison, from which there is no way out, except for various ingenious paths, hidden objects and puzzles.
The player will explore the various rooms of the prison, paying attention to every small detail and examining objects in search of key clues. Each room is filled with riddles, traps and various items that can be used to escape.

title: Math Duck
description:
You play as a fearless duck who battles enemies not with brute force, but with math smarts.

The rules are simple but addictive:
- Pick from shuffled number cards and combine them to make 10.
- Each correct match becomes your attack to damage enemies.
- Defeat foes, earn XP, and level up your duck!

Every level-up lets you choose from 3 unique upgrades. Each run is different, and your choices shape the way your duck fights.

Sharpen your mind, master the numbers, and guide your duck to victory!

title: Eco Block Puzzle
description: Unleash your creativity in a classic block puzzle game, then collect pets like in farming games! You are commanding the team of ecologists who are restoring the valley after an environmental catastrophe.

title: Mahjong Magic Islands
description:
The wonderful world of the Magic Islands is in desparate need of magic to help restore the waning natural beauty of their ancient cities with a new wild energy. Tons of mythical creatures await your help throughout these scattered island. You are their only hope to be saved, fix these wonderful magic lands back to their former beauty!

Mahjong: Tile Match features classic mahjong solitaire in a uniquely original visual format.

title: Color Block Blast 3
description:
Drag and drop the correct block into the grid. Match 3 or more tiles of the same colour to eliminate them.

Score beautiful combos while earning bonus points and watching beautiful animations take shape.

How high can you score in this endless match 3 game?

title: Delivery Now
description:
Delivery Now is an open world endless delivery game , which uses spectacular graphics and amazing audio effects to give a breathtaking game play experience.

Delivery Now is a fast paced action and racing game in which you will have to race against time to deliver these cute things, making your way through city highway traffic racers. You can make your own path towards your goal.

Let's enjoy it. What are you waiting for?

title: Klondike Solitaire
description:
Test your skill and logic with Klondike, the classic solitaire game loved by generations!

Stack the cards in ascending order, alternating colors, and complete all four suits to win the game.

With clean graphics, intuitive controls, and the option to play with one or three cards, Klondike offers hours of fun and relaxation.

Perfect for a quick break or a long strategic challenge!

title: Cricket Clash Pong
description:
Get ready to swing, hit, and defend in Cricket Clash Pong, an exhilarating blend of classic Pong gameplay and the beloved sport of cricket. This game promises endless hours of fun, challenging players to master the art of the digital pitch with a dynamic twist on traditional gameplay.

Exciting Features:
Multiple Game Modes: Whether you’re in the mood for a quick match or a full-blown tournament, Cricket Clash Pong has a mode to suit every player

title: Artillery Vs Tanks
description: In this game, you take control of an artillery unit and engage in combat against enemy tanks. The result of the battle hinges on how precisely you target your shots – will you obliterate all the tanks before they reach you, or will they overpower you? Take out your foes and collect rewards to enhance your howitzer's performance and acquire fresh, more formidable artillery weapons!

title: Jewel Legend Quest
description: The most legendary quest of your life begins! Miners from all around the world have come to get their hands on these precious gems. Join them in the effort and engage in various challenges while trying to dig out as many diamonds as possible.

title: Fidget Trading Card Toy
description: Fidget Trading Card Toy is a fidget trading game that allows you to feel the fun of collecting toy cards! In the game, you will flip cards against opponents and even use the slap feature to set off a fierce trading duel! Your goal is to collect as many rare cards as possible, increase your card collection, and gain more advantages in trading!

title: Neon Blast
description: Upgrade your defense cannons by merging them!Watch as your cannons level up and become powerful defenders, and get exciting new powers to crush bosses and attackers!

title: Jetpack Jump
description: Jetpack Jump is a fun and simple casual jumping game that lets you perform Olympic-style jumps with a little help from a jet pack strapped onto your back. Your aim is to jump as many meters as possible, constantly beating your best score. Your athlete will be rewarded generously in coins, which will help you upgrade and fly to even greater heights.

title: Car Parking Stunt Games 2024
description: Play the new challenging car game on Impossible Tracks in car stunt games 3d of 2024. Join the world of real impossible tracks in car racing games. Experience the real car parking stunt game with no limits of enjoyment. Are you a fan of Hard Parking Games 2024.

title: BMG: CrashDay 2025
description: The game "BMG: CrashDay 2025" is an arcade racing simulator that combines elements of action and realism. Players can choose from a variety of cars, each with its own unique characteristics and appearance. The game has various tracks, each with its own features, such as difficult turns, steep climbs and descents, as well as various obstacles.

title: Winter Maze
description:
Step into a frosty puzzle adventure with Winter Maze! Explore icy, snow-covered mazes and guide your ball through slippery, twisty paths that fill up with every move. Each level challenges you to think ahead, plan your route and clear the entire field to unlock the next stage.
Simply swipe to roll the ball in any direction and watch the maze come to life beneath you. Your goal is clear: cover every tile and leave no space untouched.

title: Chain Cube 2048 3D Merge Game
description:
Ready to challenge yourself? Chain Cubes 2048 is an addictive merging puzzle online game for those who like challenging brain teasers and logic puzzle merging games. Believe it or not, it's much
harder to put together 2048 cubes than it is to throw away the numbers. If you fail to merge the cube number blocks, they will bounce off each other!  Keep playing and eventually complete 2248 number puzzles!

title: Paint Roller
description: Control two tethered spheres in this unique painting challenge. Click to anchor one sphere in place while the other swings around it on an elastic tether, leaving a dynamic paint trail. Your objective? Strategically rotate your tethered pair to completely coat all target cylinders in each level.

title: Sid & Ginny Y2K Glam Clash
description: Welcome to the Y2K style fashion world! Two charismatic heroines are waiting for you, ready to try on fashion trends from the 2000s. Create spectacular makeup for them with lip gloss, shining shadows and glossy skin; choose stylish hairstyles - from smooth straight hair to playful ponytails and fashionable hairpins. Experiment with low-cut jeans, crop tops, mini skirts, shiny fabrics, and bold combinations. Complete the resulting image with iconic accessories of those years.

title: Sliding Gems
description:
Embark on an enchanting journey of matching gems! Dive into a realm filled with shimmering jewels, tactical maneuvers, and irresistible puzzle trials.

Slide and place vibrant gems to unveil newfound powers.

Confront challenges with diverse boosters to overcome obstacles and achieve higher scores.

title: Build A Queen 2025
description: In Build a Queen 2025, you will embark on a fun journey to become a real queen. You will need to make your way through different platform levels with your opponents. Choose outfits, skin colors, and more according to your goals. Dress up in the most glamorous queen look, meet the prince, and win. You can collect money to unlock more dance steps.

title: Feed me Monsters! Idle Battle
description: The fate of the world is in your hands. Will you rise to the challenge and become a beacon of hope in a land filled with darkness?

title: Sword And Spin
description: In Sword and Spin, you’re a brave warrior with a sword, racing through challenging arcade levels filled with obstacles and enemies. Use your sword to cut through everything in your path! Spin around with your greatsword.

title: Bubble Blitz Galaxy
description: Welcome to Bubble Blitz Galaxy! Aim and shoot bubbles towards similar ones to collect them while ensuring they stay away from the borderline. Experience two exciting modes: In Arcade Mode, strive to survive as long as possible and score as much as you can. In Challenge Mode, survive and achieve target scores, facing new challenges one after another. Get ready for an exhilarating bubble-blasting adventure!

title: Escape Room Mystery Key
description: Escape Room Mystery Key is an intense escape room adventure filled with horror and puzzle elements. Choose a role to enter an abandoned school or a hospital. Uncover hidden clues and keys to find your way out. In this game, you must carefully examine every detail in the room, searching for hidden clues.

title: Mall Anomaly
description: Mall Anomaly is not your usual mall trip. Instead of shopping, you’re stuck in endless hallways where mannequins stare, furniture floats, and unusual kitties vanish into thin air. Spot these bizarre anomalies before the place completely glitches out—it’s like spot the difference, but in a cursed shopping center.

title: Mahjong Connect Majong Class
description: Mahjong Connect is a classic elimination-style casual game where players need to find and connect identical mahjong tiles on the board. The game rules are simple yet challenging, suitable for players of all ages.

title: Hidden Object Farm Adventure
description: Play a fun hidden object game with 30 farm levels! each level, find 6 hidden things before time runs out. If you need help, use a hint! It's easy to play and full of colorful farm fun.

title: Grand Mahjong Connect
description:
Grand Mahjong Connect is a relaxing yet challenging triple-match puzzle game with a fresh twist on classic mahjong.

Select tiles from the board and match three identical pieces to clear them.
Plan your moves carefully — space is limited, and every choice matters!

Enjoy beautiful tiles, smooth gameplay, and satisfying match effects as you clear the board and progress through levels.

Can you master the art of triple matching?

title: Bloom Sort 2: Bee Puzzle
description: Dive into the enchanting world of Bloom Sort 2: Bee Puzzle, where flowers bloom, bees buzz, and your mind gets a delightful workout! This unique 3D puzzle game combines stunning 2D and 3D graphics with a relaxing, chill vibe, making it the perfect escape for players of all ages.

title: The Last Tiger: Tank Simulator
description:
An incredible adventure in the world of tank battles awaits you!
Get ready to immerse yourself in the exciting world of tank battles. In this game, you will take control of one of the most famous tanks of World War II, the Tiger. Your task is to survive and win the fiercest battles.

title: Tricky Life
description:
Welcome to Tricky Life, the funniest brain test puzzle game ever made!
Here, logic meets laughter every level is designed to make you giggle, think twice, and smile when you finally find the answer.

title: Golden Frontier
description: This simulation game takes you on a Wild West adventure. Mine and manage resources, grow crops and craft goods as you aim to build a thriving city in the frontier lands. Invite friends to become your neighbors to trade and co-op, and progress quicker. Hunt for gold, unlock new locations, and discover secrets as the story unfolds. Meet a colorful cast of characters, including trappers, Indians and criminals.

title: Stickman The Flash
description: Stickman The Flash is a fighting RPG arcade game with 2D stickman warriors. In the Survival Mode, you need to survive as long as you can by dodging red areas and killing incoming enemies. You can collect different weapons when you kill the corresponding enemies. When you earn enough gems, you can unlock and equip them in the Equipment Store, and they will increase your full abilities. Keep calm and slaughter them all!

title: Ropeway Master
description:
Ropeway Master is a new challenging puzzle game. You should utilize the rope to free everyone,control the rope, overcome the obstacles, and complete the demanding and unique puzzle game. The
game is not difficult! Drag the rope to make a safe path, control the rope, and rescue everyone.Don't forget to avoid the obstacles along the way. If you play Rope Puzzle, make sure you do nothing. You will play for hours and linger.

title: Candy Maker: Dessert Games
description: Do you like match-3 games, candies, and delicious cakes? Solve sweet riddles, move puzzles, and collect culinary masterpieces! Train your brain by solving exciting puzzles! Rich graphics and pleasant music will help you relax to your advantage!

title: Slime Farm!
description: Farm Slime: Slime Farm Simulator is a relaxing yet addictive game where you drive a suction truck to vacuum up unruly slimes and turn them into cash. Cruise smoothly through gooey fields, slurp with satisfying precision, sell your haul to upgrade your truck and expand your farm into a thriving slime empire.

title: Strykon
description:
Strykon is a mobile FPS game with exciting missions and battles. Play different modes like Deathmatch, Team Deathmatch, and Free-for-All, where your goal is to survive.
Choose from many weapons, like pistols, rifles, shotguns, and snipers. Each gun has its own style. Enjoy great graphics, realistic sound, and easy controls. Earn rewards with the Battle Pass to keep the game interesting. Whether you complete missions or fight enemies, this shooter is full of action anytime, anywhere!

title: Real Flight Simulator
description: Real Flight Simulator plays like an airplane driving simulation game with 3D models. In 6 levels, you can learn how to drive an airplane including starting, steering, and landing. All of the complicated instrument panels are simplified for players to learn. The more expensive the airplane you drive, the better acceleration of it you can enjoy including the Power, Speed, Solution, and Brake. Good luck in the sky!

title: Car Dealer Idle
description: Ever dreamed of becoming a top Car Dealer? In Car Dealer Idle, you’ll manage your own vehicle business. Buy and sell cars, expand your showroom, and grow into a real tycoon. Make smart management decisions, upgrade your dealership, and watch your profits skyrocket. Unlock more booths to sell cooler vehicles. Unlock repair areas, test drive areas, etc.

title: Mega Lamba Ramp
description: Crazy car stunts and stunt car racing games that will give you the most thrilling experience. Perform dangerous stunts on impossible tracks in our racing and stunt simulator. Perform stunts on all the cars for your favorite characters to move to the next level!

title: Grand Clash Arena
description:
Grand Clash Arena is a unique war game that offers an action-packed experience.

Key Features of the Game:

-Epic Combat Experience: Showcase your mastery against opponents by using every object at your disposal.

-Drop Weapons and Surprises: Alter the flow of the game with surprise drops from the sky. Surprise your opponents with powerful weapons that suddenly appear and gain an advantage.

Grand Clash Arena offers a unique gaming experience that combines the art of war and strategy.

title: CraftsMan 3D Gangster
description:
In the new action game CraftsMan 3D Gangster, which is exciting and similar to Minecraft, you may become a real-life gangster roaming the streets of the city. As you explore the open world, you'll encounter other criminals who are eager to wipe you off the map.

Get through every level of this fun 3D action game, where you'll face more frightening adversaries.

title: Hexagon
description: Embark on a merging frenzy with "Hexagon"! Place hexagonal tiles on the board, watch them merge and multiply. Create chain reactions and earn points as you strategically fill the hexagonal grid. Can you reach the ultimate merge and trigger the explosive power of 512? Play now and test your merging skills!

title: Shelf Shift Match
description: Test your strategy and speed in Shelf Shift Match! Shift items on the shelves to create perfect matches of three, clearing the way to reveal hidden shadowed items. But beware—unwise moves can block your shelves, leaving no space to shift and leading to game over! If you're stuck, use the shuffle button to mix things up and find new matches.

title: TOP HOG
description: Welcome to the forest adventure! A drowsy bear just wants to rest, but a playful group of hedgehogs  has decided to throw a party close by. Your task? Grab a hockey stick and send those troublemakers soaring through the air! Build your strength, collect bonuses to enhance your skills, and face the exciting challenges in each level. Who will rise as the winter forest champion? Become a true bear hockey expert! Simple to play, fun, and packed with thrilling airborne action! Give it a try now!

title: Online Car Destruction Simulator 3D
description: Experience a high-speed realistic car collision simulator! Drive down slopes and crash into specialized obstacles with various vehicles, all featuring authentic physics and a detailed damage system with separating parts.

title: Cube Drop Puzzle
description:
Colorful bears are waiting to splash water!

Welcome to Cube Drop Puzzle!

Are you ready to start puzzle solving? Play Cube Drop Puzzle now and make a splash!

title: Griddlers Deluxe
description: Welcome to Griddlers Deluxe! Immerse yourself in a world of captivating puzzles. Uncover hidden images by deciphering numerical clues on the grid. With almost 200 challenges, Griddlers Deluxe offers addictive brain-teasing fun. Ready to decode the mysteries? Play now!

title: Rooftop Run
description: Run, jump, and slide over rooftops in this fast-paced parkour game! Dodge obstacles, smash through barriers, and escape from enemies as you race through exciting levels.

title: Dop Puzzle Erase Master
description:
It is an interesting online game that will take you to an unparalleled puzzle-solving  experience. To solve the puzzles, you may use your imagination and ingenuity. You need to consider what do I erase to pass the level. Within the challenging levels, you  need to use strategic thinking to conquer each puzzle. In each level, you must make use of the
  eraser to erase a part of the picture to show a hidden object or scene. The deletion puzzles are  easy to learn, but challenging to master.

title: Bubble Shooter Ultimate
description: Bubble shooter ultimate is a classic bubble shooter game with a modern twist. Each level-up you get to chose a power up like a change to get a bomb or rainbow bubble and more. Create combinations of three or more matching bubbles by launching bubbles of the same color at them. The more bubbles you pop in a single shot, the higher your score. If you miss a match 5 times, the playing field moves down by one row. The objective is to score as many points as possible while clearing all the bubbles!

title: Obby Escape: Prison Rat Dance
description: Obby Escape: Prison Rat Dance is an exhilarating adventure game that merges the thrill of intricate prison escape challenges with the dynamic agility required in parkour. Assume the role of a resourceful rat striving to escape the strict surveillance of a heavily fortified prison. Find your way through elaborate mazes and overcome diverse, challenging obstacles as you plot your daring prison escape.

title: Puzzle Games: Outing Day
description: Welcome to Puzzle Game: Outing Day, a casual puzzle game online. Today is the day for an outing. What will happen with all the little animals? What activities will they have on their trip to the field? Come and explore the interesting things on the camp and solve puzzles with your animal partners. See if you are the cleverest child in the crowd!
