title: Fortress of the Sinister
description: Fortress of Sinister is a thrilling 3D strategy game that blends tactical depth with exciting challenges. Lead a team of distinctive characters through four treacherous fortresses teeming with enemies and traps. Take part in strategic turn-based battles on grid-based arenas, recruit unique units like the Mushroom Priest and Night Hunter, and unveil hidden secrets. Collect valuable loot, upgrade your skills, and unlock powerful allies to face escalating challenges and excel in survival mode.

title: Pin Master
description: Pin master: Screw puzzle quest & brain games challenges your problem-solving skills in a captivating pin puzzle adventure. Strategically tap to unlock screw holes on products, guiding metal plates to fall in the correct sequence. Navigate through intricate mazes of nuts, bolts, and plates. With each level presenting new challenges, immerse yourself in over 100 brain-teasing stages. Need a hint? No problem! Utilize the hint feature or remove random screws to progress.

title: Sunny Link
description: 'Sunny Link' is an easy and fun game where players match tiles with summer icons. The goal is to connect two identical tiles. Tiles can be linked if you can join them with three or fewer straight lines. The game has many levels to enjoy. As you play, you’ll hear sounds of the sea. It’s perfect for relaxing and having fun in the sun!

title: Strawberry Shortcake
description: Strawberry Shortcake has big dreams. She wants to be the BEST baker that Big Apple City  has ever seen and that's why she packed her bags and went to live with her Aunt Praline to the only place where a baker can go if they want to become the best in the whole world: the BIG APPLE CITY!

title: Two RX7 Drifters
description: Drift through 3 stunning drift tracks and show how well you can steer the wheels of a powerful rx7. Go head to head with your friend in a drift battle and see whose a better drift racer, customize your ride with stunning body colors, underglows and cool rims. Are you ready to showcase your drifting skills?

title: Crown & Cannon
description: Crown & Cannon is a fast-paced 2D strategy game where players expand territory, deploy various weapons, and battle dynamic AI on destructible terrain. It features upgradeable units, strategic combat, and is optimized for Web platforms and cross platform.

title: Fashion Battle for Survival
description: In this puzzle game you have to test your memory by guessing the cards in pairs. Each correctly guessed pair brings you closer to winning the game round. And each successfully completed round opens the doors to the world of fashion, allowing you to dress up the main character of the game - an Asian beauty with a daring character. Remember that the time to complete the round is limited by a timer.

title: Run N Shoot
description: You run and you shoot. That’s all you do, but this deceptively simple game mixes up the action and racks up the adrenalin with surprises round every corner to ensure you never get bored. Trigger finger itchy?

title: Stickman in space
description:
You have to play as a Stickman astronaut who is stuck on the moon.
Use all possible ways to leave the moon and get to our planet Earth.
On the way you will encounter various dangers, such as aliens, flying meteorites and much more.
You will have several objects in your hands with which you can try to escape from the natural satellite of the moon. Several objects will lead you to death, and some objects can save your life, be careful and cautious.

title: MeatRider
description: Welcome to "MeatRider" — an intense action-packed game set in a post-apocalyptic world overrun by zombies. You find yourself right in the middle of the chaos, where your only goal is to survive at all costs. Choose one of the unique combat vehicles, each with its own special abilities and weapons, and get ready for dynamic battles across a zombie-infested desert landscape.

title: Emilys Hotel Solitaire
description: What are you going to do when you go on a journey to a tropical island? Will you spend your time in a lounger, enjoying the hot sun and cold drinks, or become a master surfer? Our heroine Emily has arrived at this heavenly place to make her honorable grandfather Douglas Kirby’s dream to build a hotel of his own come true.

title: Emoji Frenzy
description:
Test your reflexes and knowledge in this fast-paced emoji matching game! 
Tap the correct emoji before time runs out, build streaks, and unlock new themes. Simple to play, hard to master!

title: Fix Da Brainrot
description: Fix Da Brainrot is a quirky jigsaw puzzle game with pieces that look like torn paper. Pick your challenge —16 pieces for a quick and easy fix or 32 pieces for a real brain teaser. Drag, drop, and fit the torn pieces together, and watch the picture slowly come alive as you fix the brainrot and conquer the puzzle!

title: Neighborhood Defense
description: Neighborhood Defense is a dynamic tower defense strategy game where your mission is to protect your neighborhood from waves of zombies. Diverse maps with multiple exits, different types of enemies, and limited tower spots make each match unique. Upgrade your towers, combine their abilities, and plan your tactics carefully to stop the horde and prevent them from breaking through.

title: ASMR Beauty Superstar
description: Welcome to ASMR Clinic, where relaxation meets rejuvenation! Our superstar guest is receiving expert care for acne-prone skin and rough feet in a serene atmosphere. Our skilled doctors will work their magic, providing personalized attention to detail and soothing care. Customize her look with various hairstyles, makeup looks, and shoes to create a stunning outfit that's uniquely hers. Unwind and express your creativity in this calming and fashionable game.

title: Line on Hole
description: Dive into the addictive world of Line of Hole! Start with simple lines, progress to complex patterns. Earn coins for each level, unlock vibrant backgrounds. Use hints when stuck, test your logic, and enjoy endless fun!

title: Sudo Tetroid Daily
description: A new fresh way of playing your favorite sudoku puzzles have just arrived! Play your way through all levels or challenge yourself in the daily mode! Come back everyday for new challenges!

title: Twilight Solitaire TriPeaks
description: Step into the shadows with Twilight Solitaire TriPeaks! Explore abandoned castles, fend off lurking vampires, and rebuild forgotten halls. Play 200+ haunting Solitaire levels plus 50 chilling Mahjong boards. Face spooky twists like frozen and locked cards, tricky obstacles, and powerful boosts. Search the dark, cobwebby corners of every last level for gems and coins to purchase new castle upgrades and power-ups. Are you ready for a Solitaire adventure that sends shivers down your spine?

title: Mustang City Driver
description: Dive into city driving with four game modes. Navigate realistic traffic and monitor your fuel while exploring busy streets. Enjoy stunning night city graphics, transforming the city into a neon-lit spectacle. Pedestrians add unpredictability, and hitting them triggers police chases. Customize your car's appearance and performance. All this chaos is accompanied by your cute dog. Whether evading the cops or just cruising, Mustang City Driver offers a thrilling and visually amazing experience.

title: Contract Deer Hunter
description: Step into the shoes of a skilled hunter in Contract Deer Hunter, an immersive 3D hunting game where precision and strategy are key. Accept challenging contracts to hunt wild animals in various environments, including dense forests and open plains. Your mission is to take down your targets with precision to earn cash rewards. The better your aim and the more vital the hit, the greater the payout!

title: Deep in the Lab - Chapter 1
description: Deep in the Lab is 2D '90 style survival horror game, with old style pre-rendered backgrounds, puzzles to solve, keys to collect, monster to avoid or defeat (your choice), poor resources, jumpscares, limited saves, FMV and a five floors lab to explore.

title: Tower Defense
description: In Tower Defense, you will direct a powerful army of defense towers to face enemy attacks. Arrange your defense towers carefully and develop the strategy to repel the enemy. Each tower has different attack powers and abilities. Unlock the right type and placement. Update your soldiers to help you battle. Use your crossbow to take them out.

title: 2048 Cube Shooting Merge
description: 2048 Cube Shooting Merge is an addictive merge puzzle online game for those who like challenging brain teasers and logic puzzle merge games. This game is in 3D with crazy fun physics! The squares don't stay in place, they pop up. The gameplay is much simpler. If you like 2048 games and want to play a novel mode, join the game.

title: Find It Fast
description: Discover the ultimate hidden object game! Test your observation skills by uncovering hidden items in fun, challenging levels. Relax and enjoy this scavenger hunt adventure with stunning puzzles. Focus on listed items, tap to reveal hidden objects, and race against time to unlock vibrant maps. Explore interactive scenes, solve puzzles, and prove yourself as the scavenger hunt master! Enjoy free gameplay, endless entertainment, and thrilling challenges. Play now and see what you can FIND!

title: Flower Sort
description:
Sort Flowers is a bright and relaxing puzzle game where you sort flowers by type!
Combine three identical flowers in one pot to grow a lush, beautiful bush.
Plan your moves, create satisfying merge chains, and enjoy the colorful and cozy atmosphere.
Each level brings new combinations, vibrant colors, and delightful visual effects.

title: Knit Bears
description: Knit Bears is a cozy and colorful puzzle game where you help adorable teddy bears come to life by knitting them from soft yarn. Choose a bear, place it in the center, and matching yarn balls will start wrapping it up. Each teddy bear needs three yarns to be fully knitted, so plan your moves carefully. If the board fills with unfinished bears that can’t be completed, the game ends.

title: 2020 Connect
description:
2020 Connect is the most addictive logic puzzle you’ve ever seen! The player’s task is to place at least four blocks with the same number on it next to each other so they get merged. 2020 Connect takes the best ideas of games like Merged and 2048 and turns it into a total blast. Merging more than four blocks will reward you with coins that later can be spend to purchase cool boosters. 
Will you be able to get the legendary 8192 blocks to merge?

title: Build A Rich Queen
description: Make the most accurate choice and become the most beautiful queen! In Build A Rich Queen, you will bring your credit card. When you encounter a POS machine on the road, you can directly swipe the card to buy clothes and other decorations. These decorations will allow you to pass obstacles without directly failing the game, but you will lose these decorations. But pay attention to the road under your feet, don't fall suddenly, otherwise, you will directly fail the game.

title: Ghostly Graveyard Halloween Special
description:
This Halloween, experience the thrill of Ghostly Graveyard is a spooky platformer adventure where you explore a haunted graveyard and unravel its mysteries. Navigate challenging levels, collect coins, and avoid ghostly encounters. Can you solve the graveyard's secrets?
A Halloween Special Spooky Puzzle Adventure.

title: Ellie and Friends Venice Carnival
description: Step into the glamorous world of Venice Carnival Dressup with Ellie and Friends Venice Carnival, where you can join Ellie and her friends at one of the most extravagant events of the year. The Venice Carnival is all about stunning masks, luxurious costumes, and endless glamour, and now you get to help Ellie and her friends get ready for the big celebration! Design unique looks and create the perfect carnival style with a variety of costumes, accessories, and masks.

title: TapKO
description: One-tap fighter game. From the creators of Fruit Ninja and Jetpack Joyride, get ready to rumble with TapKO - the knockout idle game that packs a punch! Jab, bob, and weave your way to the top, and train your fighter to become the ultimate boxer.

title: Penguin Adventure
description: Join the penguin’s adventure in Penguin Adventure! You will play as a penguin who must reach the castle in each level. You will explore three worlds, each with its own challenges and surprises. You will also have to control the penguin’s actions. You will collect stars and hearts along the way, which will affect your score and rewards. You will need enough yellow stars to unlock the next world. Penguin Adventure is a game that will test your reaction and strategy. Don’t miss this fun game!

title: Obby Halloween Danger Skate
description: Obby is skateboarding on the rooftops and performing dangerous tricks. He wants to skateboard on the rooftops during Halloween. Help Obby reach the finish line safely. You must be very careful! Since it's Halloween, the city is flooded with toxic water, and if you fall from the building, you will die. Jump from barrels to containers and climb to the top of the building. Collect all the pumpkins along the way to earn money. Gather all the pumpkins and reach the finish line!

title: Royal Bubble Blast
description: Welcome to Royal Bubble Blast, where you'll be transported to a majestic castle to enjoy a royal Bubble Shooter experience! Featuring vibrant, handcrafted designs and a colourful, lively theme, this game offers endless, relaxing gameplay accompanied by a beautiful soundtrack. Play as a King or Queen in the most exclusive Bubble Shooter enjoyed by royalty. Dive into a world of colourful bubbles and endless fun. So, what are you waiting for? Join the royals and start popping!

title: Choo Choo Spider Monster Train
description:
Welcome to the most terrifying train ride of your life!
Cho-Cho Scary Charles: Spider Train is a chilling open-world survival horror shooter where your only lifeline is a small yellow train armed with a machine gun and a whole lot of courage.
Face off against Charles — the monstrous spider-train hybrid that haunts a remote island, preying on unsuspecting humans. No one knows where he came from, but one thing is clear — he won't stop until he's fed.

title: One Line
description: One Line is a casual art drawing game where your mission is to use a single line to protect an innocent man from a series of unfortunate events. From shielding him against heavy rain to fending off aggressive bees and even angry giants, each level presents a new challenge. Get creative and use the power of One Line to ensure he stays safe, all while enjoying the simple yet satisfying drawing mechanics. The more you play, the more you'll need to think outside the box to keep him protected!

title: Homo Evolution
description: Create your own world and guide human evolution! Merge creatures, unlock eight evolution stages, and shape civilization from tiny spores to modern life. Explore new planets, experiment with unique paths, and enjoy endless fun in this captivating evolution game. Play now!

title: Ball Jump Switch The Colors
description:
Tap on the screen, that will make the ball bounce higher and higher. The ball has one color, and can pass through obstacle with the same color, or sneak in between obstacles with different colors.

Easy-to-play and addictive !

title: Kaboom Miner
description:
A fast-paced logical arcade inspired by classic Boulder Dash, but taken to the next level with massive chain explosions.
Your goal is simple—but dangerous: destroy all 50 explosive crates. Use falling stones, carefully placed bombs, and clever terrain manipulation to trigger devastating chain reactions. Every move matters. Push stones, move crates, build bridges from bricks, and even trap the Ghost before finishing it off.

title: Ball Rolling Slope
description:
Navigate a rolling ball through endless neon slopes in the Ball Rolling Slope game! Test your reflexes, dodge obstacles, and aim for the highest score in this challenge.
Ball Rolling Slope game is an exhilarating 3D arcade game that puts your reflexes and precision to the ultimate test. Guide a rolling ball down a steep, neon-lit slope filled with challenging obstacles and sudden drops. The gameplay is simple to pick up but difficult to master.

title: Idle Firefighter 3D
description: Idle Firefighter 3D is a single player firefighter simulator game. You will play the role of a firefighter and it is your duty to save the survivors from the fire. Here, new emergencies are constantly occurring and you need to be on standby and must put out the fires as soon as possible! The fire extinguisher is your friend, if the props run out, you will not be able to put out the fire.

title: Stick Boy: Bazooka Ragdoll
description: Unleash chaos in Stick Boy: Bazooka War! Blast through levels with a variety of powerful bazookas, each with unique abilities. Obliterate enemies, destroy bases, and demolish everything in your path. Choose the perfect ammo to send ragdoll foes flying and experience thrilling destruction as you crush their strongholds. Help Stick Boy annihilate all adversaries and conquer every level in this explosive adventure!

title: Screw Puzzle Master
description: Pull out the nuts and bolts and release the woods. Get ready for a fluent and entertaining screw puzzle! It is time to do some brain practice. Many game levels, entertaining puzzles, and super power-ups await you!  Challenge a friend and complete chapters as fast as you can. Place the bolts as strategically as you can. Buy different skins and play in a different ambient.

title: My Dreamy Flora Fashion Look
description: Welcome to My Dreamy Flora Fashion Look. Girls! You know that spring is on its way when you see the trees starting to bud and bloom, and the bulbs you planted last fall start to sprout out of the ground. Join with Ellie and their friends to celebrate the most beautiful and colorful season.

title: Snake Masters
description:
Control a small worm and get ready to reach the other side of the screen. Enjoy a puzzle inspired by the classic Snake, where you must guide the worm to the other side of the apple and escape safely. Will you be smart enough to beat all thirty levels?

Game Features
- Special crawling mechanics.
- Challenge your brain.
- Tons of interesting puzzles.
- Easy controls.

title: Smash the Car to Pieces!
description: Shoot the car with guns. Launch a combat drone or summon a tornado. Ram the car with a giant hammer or blow up all the windows with dynamite. There are many ways to destroy a car waiting for you in this game.

title: Wool Sorting
description:
Wool Sorting is a super relaxing and addictive yarn-connecting puzzle game!
In LEVEL 2, slide and merge colorful wool segments to create perfect complete threads. Match colors and sequences with precision — simple to play, yet deeply satisfying!
Challenge yourself across LV.10, 15 & 20. Soothing, brain-teasing fun for any moment!

title: Marble Blast
description: Ready to match, blast, and conquer? This vibrant marble shooter game offers endless fun and challenges that test your skills and strategy. Clear colorful marbles, unlock powerful boosters, and prove you’re the master of marble puzzles! Whether you’re a casual gamer or a puzzle enthusiast, this game delivers excitement like no other.

title: Daily Chess Puzzle
description: Enjoy over 700 daily chess puzzles in a sunny, beach-themed world. Lighthearted, relaxing, and perfect for summer fun anytime.

title: Color Nuts
description:
Color Nuts is a relaxing and addictive color-matching puzzle game where you place colorful nuts on the board and connect three or more of the same color to clear them.

Plan your moves carefully, complete level objectives, and keep the board from filling up. Easy to learn and hard to master, Color Nuts is the perfect casual puzzle game for fans of match-3, block puzzles, and logic games.

title: Unscrew Wood Puzzle
description: Unscrew Wood Puzzle: Screw Jam is an engaging puzzle game that combines logic, strategy, and dexterity in a tactile experience. Players are challenged to solve intricate puzzles involving bolts, nuts, and screws. With hundreds of unique levels, this game provides a blend of relaxation and mental stimulation, perfect for casual gamers and puzzle enthusiasts alike. The beautifully designed wooden and metallic elements create a visually appealing and satisfying gameplay experience.

title: Dead Zone Mech Ops
description:
Dead Zone: Mech Ops thrusts players into the heart of a scorched Earth ravaged by endless war, where autonomous factions and rogue AI compete for control over the planet’s last remaining strongholds. You are a combat pilot in the elite “Mech Ops” unit — the final line of defense in a world on the brink of total collapse.
Players will command next-gen combat exosuits equipped with modular weapon systems, advanced targeting tech, and adaptive armor that reacts to battlefield conditions.

title: Challenger City Driver
description: Get ready to skid the wheels of a stunning muscle through an expansive morning city map! Customize and upgrade your sports car with cool upgradables and become the best driver in the city. Take your dog with you in 3 driving challenges and conquer the missions together. Use nitro to beat slow traffic and beat all speed, stunt and drift triggers spread across the map. Are you ready to show your driving skills? Prove yourself!

title: Puppy Merge
description: Puppy Merge is a unique merge game where you must grab and combine identical puppies to create a new and bigger one. Puppies will fall automatically into the arena; what you must do is drag the puppies around and merge them into identical ones. Don't let the puppies fall outside the box, or the game will end. You can try to catch the puppy and bring it back to the arena if the puppy falls.

title: Caterfall 2048
description: Caterfall 2048 is a vibrant reimagining of the classic 2048 puzzle set in a cozy feline atmosphere. It combines familiar merging mechanics with a hexagonal grid and fun "jelly" physics. This game is perfect for all puzzle lovers — whether you want to relax or you're a competitive player striving for a new high score.

title: Merge Gun Fps Shooting Zombie
description: Merge Gun: FPS Shooting Zombie's main mission is to shoot down all coming undead creatures before they kill you. Before you join the battle, you can buy more guns and merge the same guns into new advanced ones. With more powerful and fast ammo in the clip, you can deal with incoming enemies more easily. Both zombies and crows will move forward to you even if you are still reloading. Keep calm and shoot the explosive oil cans on the ground if necessary.

title: Combine Pickaxes
description:
Start with simple tools and upgrade them to powerful devices that can destroy any obstacles! Buy, combine and power up tools to earn more money for destroying rocks, trees and other objects.**
Goal: become a master of destruction, collect a powerful arsenal and conquer all levels. Think over your strategy, upgrade your tools and prove that you can handle any obstacles!

title: Backgammon Deluxe Edition
description:
Want to try a different kind of game of luck? Enjoy the best board game of luck, Backgammon Deluxe!

Challenge your friend to a game of chance and trust in the dice roll. Roll the dice with all your might and pray for a lucky number!

Who will come out on top in the end? Play now, and let's find out!

title: GunFu Stickman 2
description:
Armed with a pistol in each hand, take control of the famous Stickman from the "Gun Fu" series and blast through hordes of enemies!

Reflexes and reaction times will be challenged and put to the test as the never-ending onslaught gets faster and faster!

Unlock more deadly guns and outfits, and customize your Stickman to suit your style!

title: SHOT CAN WILD
description: Keep tapping to shoot and prevent the can from falling! The game ends when you run out of ammo. Hit the center of te target for a COOL SHOT! Chain COOL SHOT to restore ammo!

title: Snow Rider Obby Parkour
description:
Snow Rider Obby Parkour is a fast-paced snowboard adventure where reflexes, timing, and control matter. Play solo or with a friend in split-screen mode and experience different snow challenges across multiple game modes. Whether you want to beat distance records, explore a massive open world, or race down dangerous mountains, this game offers a complete snowboarding experience.

Master your snowboard, perform double jumps, and unlock amazing gear to customize your character!

title: Christmas Blind Box‌
description: This is a Christmas toy blind box opening game! Click the "Open" button to test your luck—can you beat the high score for the number of Christmas toys collected?

title: Ellie and Ben Christmas Eve
description: Celebrate the magic of the holiday season with Ellie and Ben Christmas Eve, a delightful game where players join Ellie and Ben as they prepare for the most wonderful night of the year. From decorating the tree to picking the perfect outfits, this game brings the charm of Christmas to life in a fun and interactive way.

title: Candy Match Puzzle
description:
Dive into a delightful puzzle experience with Candy Puzzle Match, where matching candies is all about tapping! Simply tap on groups of two or more adjacent candies of the same color to clear them from the board. The more candies you clear at once, the higher your score!

Watch the board shift and cascade with every move as you complete deliciously fun objectives. With colorful visuals and satisfying chain reactions, this game is perfect for fans of casual and relaxing puzzle games.

title: G Wagon City Driver
description: Dive into city driving with four game modes. Navigate busy morning streets, managing fuel and realistic traffic. Venture beyond the city to tackle rugged offroad terrain. Stunning morning graphics bring the city and landscapes to life, while unpredictable pedestrians and police chases add excitement. Customize your G-Wagon's look and performance, and enjoy the ride with your loyal dog. Whether evading cops or exploring trails, G-Wagon City Driver offers a thrilling experience.

title: DTA: Best Thief
description:
Can you steal everything without getting caught? Test your agility and cunning!
In "GTA: Top Thief" you will find:

- Lots of shops and difficulties with different goods
- Smart administrators – be careful!
- Improve your skills - become stealthier and faster
- Steal from sprunky, roblox and granny
- Go through the story with exciting quests
- Collect pets and stand out among thieves

Each successful heist brings you closer to the title of the best thief in "GTA: Top Thief"!

title: Tile Fruits
description: In Tile Fruits, embark on a delectable adventure packed with vibrant fruits and captivating challenges! This 2D tile-matching game tests your strategic prowess as you aim to connect three identical fruits to advance through progressively difficult levels. Each match removes the fruits from the board, but beware: having more than seven different types of fruits on the board at once results in a loss.

title: Knee Case Simulator
description: Knee Case Simulator is a delightful beauty and doctor simulation game where you get to showcase your medical skills and fashion sense! Help Tiara recover from her knee injury and give her a stylish makeover once she's feeling better.

title: Light Line
description: Can you fill this maze with a single touch? Light Line is a game where you fill in every empty square with a single touch. Try harder stages as much as possible. Move the light lines to the delight of filling in the blanks perfectly.

title: Knots
description: Knots is a colorful HTML5 puzzle game for all ages! This is a simple logic puzzle where players move puzzle pieces to arrange the knot drawings correctly. Move hexagon tiles to connect matching knots and create beautiful patterns. Easy to learn, relaxing to play, and perfect for kids and adults — with lots of bright levels and fun challenges for the whole family!

title: Traffic Tap Puzzle
description: Traffic Tap Puzzle is a challenging puzzle game where players must control traffic at intersections by tapping on cars to start or stop them. The goal is to avoid collisions while ensuring a smooth flow of vehicles. As the levels progress, traffic becomes more complex, requiring strategic timing and quick decision-making. With engaging mechanics and increasing difficulty, the game tests your reflexes and planning skills.

title: Demolition Derby Derby
description: Welcome to Demolition Derby the mobile sensation where you control the chaos! Strategically tap to toss dynamite and swipe to send rocks crashing down. Decimate buildings and statues with precision in this hyper-casual game.

title: Monster Dash
description:
Sprint, Jump and Blast your way through Monster Dash, an action-packed game by the creators of Jetpack Joyride and Fruit Ninja.

Join Barry Steakfries and his iconic Machine Gun Jetpack in a world full of menacing monster mayhem, as you run and gun your way through hordes of zombies, vampires and more with the most explosive and powerful weapons you can find!

title: Halloween Stickman
description: On Halloween when the air was thick with mystery and the streets were decorated with carved pumpkins, you were ready to enjoy the spooky night. But Stickman, your sly friend and perennial trickster set you up and you are in trouble. It's time to punish him in every possible way. How? Yes, you have the super ability to rewind time. So take advantage of it and  punish your enemy on Halloween!

title: Italian Brainrot Jigsaw
description: Italian Brainrot Jigsaw is a funny puzzle game with the most popular meme characters. You can select one of the fifteen images and then select one of the four modes (16, 36, 64 and 100 pieces). Select your favorite picture and complete the jigsaw in the shortest time possible! Have fun and enjoy!

title: 3D Maze Control
description: 3D Maze Control is a casual and fun puzzle physics game. Your goal is to rotate the board to let the ball reach its goal. The ball always falls down due to gravity and beware of scary aliens on the way.

title: Horror Escape Granny Room
description:
In case you are ready for a creepy adventure full of horror and exploration, then choose Horror Escape: Granny Room without hesitation! In our game, you are going to go on a dangerous journey.
Collect clues and keys while trying to escape the clutches of horrible granny. Your path is full of dangers. You must dodge the monsters lurking in the dark corners.  To unlock these areas, you must collect keys and reveal secrets. What awaits you? Only time will tell.

title: Solitaire Story Tripeaks 6
description: The highly anticipated 6th installment of one of the most popular Solitaire Story card games of all time! Your good friend Foxy will take you on a journey to new destinations, visiting countries, landscapes, and landmarks like Japan, Egypt, Brazil, Korea, New Zealand, Madagascar, North Pole, and Fiji. With 6700+ levels, Daily Missions, Weekly Air Balloon and Pet Events, and dozens of new card designs, this is the biggest Solitaire Story game yet!

title: Anime Couple: Avatar Maker
description: Anime Couple: Avatar Maker is your ultimate creative escape into the world of anime character design. Craft stunning anime couples with romantic flair, dress up stylish girl avatars, and mix and match accessories, hairstyles, and outfits. With relaxing ASMR touches and a vibrant anime art style, this avatar creator lets your imagination shine in every love-filled duo you design.

title: Cinema Business - Idle Games
description:
Build and manage your own cinema empire! 
Unlock movie rooms, snack and burger corners to attract more customers.
Hire staff, upgrade facilities, and keep your theater running smoothly.
Earn cash even while you’re offline and grow your business.
Become the ultimate cinema tycoon in this fun idle arcade game!

title: Uphill Rush 13
description: Introducing the new, thirteenth game in the Uphill Rush series, and this time in a new setting - a Water Park! Dive into (pun intended) the atmosphere of water fun, riding different types of tubes, surfboards and even jet skis! Unlock new power-ups and skins by overcoming obstacles, such as loops and long jumps. But don't be scared of them, they are your best friends when it comes to stunts, which give you bonuses! Not to mention, make you look insanely cool.

title: 21 Cards
description: 21 Cards is a fun and addictive blackjack-style puzzle game where your goal is to reach exactly 21 points in each column. The game combines the thrill of classic card play with a cozy, home-style atmosphere. Place cards wisely, complete columns, and aim for the perfect 21!

title: Bingo Halloween
description: A Halloween-themed bingo game where you can win exciting bingos to unlock spooky candy-themed images. Enjoy multiple call speeds and progressive unlocks.

title: Sort Game Toy Sort
description: Enjoy some adorable sorting fun in Sort Game: Toy Sort. This delightful match 3 puzzle and casual sort game challenges you to organize colorful dolls and toys. Match and eliminate all dolls within the limited time. When you encounter difficulties, use items to help you quickly clear the level. Such as Convert, Eliminate, Refresh or Break.
